title: Exploring the potential mechanisms of Da ChaiHu decoction against pancreatic cancer based on network pharmacology prediction and molecular docking approach.
authors: Mu, Dong; Chen, Beijin; Liu, Xiaoli; Zheng, Shumei; Zhang, Yong; Ni, Hua; Zhou, Dejiang
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究大柴胡汤抗胰腺癌机制，虽涉及DNA结合转录因子活性及分子模拟，但核心是药物-靶点互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Da ChaiHu decoction (DCHD) is used in Chinese medicine to treat pancreatic cancer (PC), but its exact mechanism is not known. The aim of this study was to investigate the main active ingredients and specific mechanisms of DCHD against PC. Firstly, the active ingredients and targets of DCHD and PC-related targets were searched from the TCMSP, DrugBank, NCBI and GeneCards databases, respectively. The intersected targets of both were then taken to construct a PPI network using STRING, and this network was visualized by Cytoscape 3.8.2. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of the intersected targets were performed using R 4.2.1 "clusterProfiler", "enrichplot", and "ggplot2" packages. Molecular docking was performed utilizing MOE software to detect the binding capacity between compounds and targets. Cell proliferation, apoptosis, invasion and migration were examined through a CCK8 kit, Muse(R) Cell Analyzer, transwell and wound healing experiment, respectively. The expression levels of five core targets were assessed by RT-qPCR in PANC-1 cells treated with stigmasterol. Molecular dynamic simulations analysis was conducted to analyze the binding affinities and modes of interaction between molecules and stigmasterol using the GROMACS 5.1.4 program package. In this study, 141 common targets of DCHD and PC were obtained. GO-MF items indicated that DCHD exerts its effects on PC primarily by influencing the binding activity of DNA-binding transcription factors. The KEGG analysis revealed that these genes were implicated in various signaling pathways, including the IL-17 signaling pathway and the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Stigmasterol was chosen as the final ingredient for subsequent investigation due to its derivation from herb (Da ChaiHu), its encompassment of more common targets, and the scarcity of existing research on its role in PC. The results of molecular docking and Molecular dynamic simulations analysis showed that stigmasterol had good binding activity with BCL2, and ICAM1. In vitro experiments suggested that stigmasterol could effectively inhibit the proliferation, invasion and migration of PANC-1 cells, and promote cell apoptosis. Moreover, stigmasterol treatment led to the reduced expression of AKT1, HIF1A, BCL2, IL1B, and ICAM1. This study is the first to reveal the main active components and potential mechanisms of DCHD against PC, which provides a theoretical basis for studying the role of DCHD in the treatment of PC. Especially, the anti-PC mechanism of active compound stigmasterol might be associated with inhibiting proliferation, invasion and migration and accelerating apoptosis. Furthermore, five targets (AKT1, HIF1A, BCL2, IL1B, and ICAM1) were identified as key targets of stigmasterol, and the mRNA expressions of these genes were down-regulated by stigmasterol through in vitro experiments.
abstract_zh: 大柴胡汤（DCHD）在中医中用于治疗胰腺癌（PC），但其确切机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨DCHD抗PC的主要活性成分及具体机制。首先，分别从TCMSP、DrugBank、NCBI和GeneCards数据库中检索DCHD的活性成分及靶点，以及PC相关靶点。随后，取两者交集靶点，利用STRING构建PPI网络，并通过Cytoscape 3.8.2进行可视化。使用R 4.2.1中的“clusterProfiler”、“enrichplot”和“ggplot2”包对交集靶点进行GO和KEGG富集分析。利用MOE软件进行分子对接，以检测化合物与靶点之间的结合能力。通过CCK8试剂盒、Muse(R)细胞分析仪、transwell和伤口愈合实验分别检测细胞增殖、凋亡、侵袭和迁移。在经豆甾醇处理的PANC-1细胞中，通过RT-qPCR评估五个核心靶点的表达水平。使用GROMACS 5.1.4程序包进行分子动力学模拟分析，以分析分子与豆甾醇之间的结合亲和力及相互作用模式。本研究中，共获得DCHD和PC的141个共同靶点。GO-MF条目表明，DCHD主要通过影响DNA结合转录因子的结合活性来发挥其对PC的作用。KEGG分析显示，这些基因涉及多种信号通路，包括IL-17信号通路和PI3K/Akt信号通路。豆甾醇因其来源于草药（大柴胡）、涵盖更多共同靶点，且现有关于其在PC中作用的研究较少，被选为后续研究的最终成分。分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析结果表明，豆甾醇与BCL2和ICAM1具有良好的结合活性。体外实验提示，豆甾醇能有效抑制PANC-1细胞的增殖、侵袭和迁移，并促进细胞凋亡。此外，豆甾醇处理导致AKT1、HIF1A、BCL2、IL1B和ICAM1的表达降低。本研究首次揭示了DCHD抗PC的主要活性成分及潜在机制，为研究DCHD在PC治疗中的作用提供了理论基础。特别是，活性化合物豆甾醇的抗PC机制可能与其抑制增殖、侵袭和迁移以及加速凋亡有关。此外，通过体外实验，五个靶点（AKT1、HIF1A、BCL2、IL1B和ICAM1）被确定为豆甾醇的关键靶点，且这些基因的mRNA表达在豆甾醇作用下下调。
